print('MT genes',ad.var.mt.sum())

import scanpy as sc, numpy as np
ad=sc.read_h5ad('raw_counts.h5ad')
ad.var['mt']=ad.var_names.str.upper().str.startswith('MT-')
sc.pp.calculate_qc_metrics(ad,qc_vars=['mt'],inplace=True,log1p=False)
# retain reasonable cellular profiles; discard low-complexity/mitochondrial and likely doublets
keep=(ad.obs.n_genes_by_counts>=600)&(ad.obs.pct_counts_mt<15)&(ad.obs.n_genes_by_counts<=5500)
print(keep.value_counts(), 'retained',keep.mean())
ad=ad[keep].copy()
sc.pp.normalize_total(ad,target_sum=1e4)
sc.pp.log1p(ad)
ad.raw=ad
sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(ad,n_top_genes=3000,flavor='seurat')
print('hvg',ad.var.highly_variable.sum())
sc.pp.scale(ad,max_value=10)
sc.tl.pca(ad,n_comps=50,use_highly_variable=True,svd_solver='arpack')
sc.pp.neighbors(ad,n_neighbors=15,n_pcs=40)
sc.tl.umap(ad,random_state=0)
for r in [.4,.6,.8,1.0]: sc.tl.leiden(ad,resolution=r,key_added=f'leiden_{r}',random_state=0)
print(ad.obs[[f'leiden_{r}' for r in [.4,.6,.8,1.0]]].apply(lambda x:x.value_counts()).to_string())
ad.write_h5ad('processed.h5ad')
